constraints: Off by default; user-initiated via request/2 decision field or --use-jev
Every acceptance/security/completion gate stays deterministic; Jev never owns authority
Advisory data must never enter requestDigest, receipts, cursor, closure, or verification status
Build in a wt/jev-optin worktree; regenerate capabilities.json + bootstrap payload/index
Provider is selected by env (CSM_DECISION_PROVIDER, default openrouter); each provider's key is read only from its own env var
No provider or decision data in requestDigest, receipts, cursor, closure, or verification status
Unknown CSM_DECISION_PROVIDER fails open to the deterministic harness; never PAUSED
deliverables: csm-decision/1, request/2, capabilities/3 schemas registered and loadable
Host-mediated, provider-pluggable decision transport (OpenRouter default; Vercel AI Gateway and other routes pluggable by descriptor) + packed CLI
Guarded routing apply + fail-open to the harness model
Full apply set and advisory points under a global switch, bounded by caps/cache
Hardening: caps, telemetry, runbook, cap-compliant SKILL.md documentation
